acls.description: Access control rules specifying which sources can reach which destinations. Both legacy (users/ports) and current (src/dst) forms are accepted.

autoApprovers.description: Rules for automatically approving route or exit-node advertisements without manual admin action.

groups.description: Named groups of users, prefixed 'group:'. Values are lists of user emails, tags, or other groups.

hosts.description: Named aliases for IP addresses or CIDR ranges, usable in place of IPs anywhere in the policy.

tagOwners.description: Defines who may apply each tag (prefixed 'tag:') to devices. Values are user emails or groups.

derpMap.description: Custom DERP relay configuration, extending or replacing Tailscale's built-in DERP infrastructure.

tests.description: Test assertions verified on every policy update; a failing test blocks the update from taking effect.

ssh.description: Tailscale SSH access control rules governing which users may open SSH sessions to which devices.

nodeAttrs.description: Rules that grant capability attributes (e.g. funnel, mullvad, app-connector) to matched devices.

disableIPv4.description: Disables IPv4 routing within the tailnet when true.

oneCGNATRoute.description: Assigns the full CGNAT range (100.64.0.0/10) as a route on a single device, rather than per-device.

randomizeClientPort.description: Randomizes the WireGuard listen port on each connection for additional NAT traversal privacy.

grants.description: Fine-grained access grants (newer alternative to acls) with per-IP or per-app destination controls.

ipsets.description: Named sets of IP addresses or CIDRs (prefixed 'ipset:') for reuse across multiple rules.

postures.description: Named device posture checks (prefixed 'posture:') evaluated against device attribute values.

defaultSrcPosture.description: Posture checks applied to all traffic sources by default, unless overridden by a per-rule srcPosture.

routes.description: Maps subnet CIDRs to tags or users whose devices are auto-approved to advertise those routes.

exitNode.description: Tags or users whose devices are auto-approved to advertise themselves as exit nodes.

regions.description: Custom DERP regions keyed by integer region ID.

omitDefaultRegions.description: When true, only the regions in this map are used; Tailscale's built-in regions are omitted.

hostName.description: DNS hostname of the DERP relay.

certName.description: TLS certificate hostname if different from HostName.

stunOnly.description: If true, this node provides STUN only, not DERP relay.

regionID.description: Unique numeric ID for this DERP region (must not collide with Tailscale's built-in IDs).

avoid.description: If true, this region is used only as a last-resort fallback.

nodes.description: DERP relay nodes in this region.

action.description: Whether to accept or deny matching traffic. One of: 'accept', 'deny'.

src.description: Source identities: user emails, groups (group:x), tags (tag:x), autogroups, IPs, CIDRs, host aliases, or '*'.

dst.description: Destination targets with optional port specifier, e.g. 'host:80', 'tag:x:22-443', or '*:*'.

proto.description: IP protocol restriction: 'tcp', 'udp', 'icmp', etc. Omit to match all protocols.

srcPosture.description: Posture check names that must pass for traffic from the source to be accepted.

action.description: SSH connection action: 'accept', 'check' (require IdP re-auth), or 'deny'.

users.description: OS-level usernames permitted for the session, e.g. 'root' or 'autogroup:nonroot'.

src.description: Source identities allowed to initiate SSH sessions.

dst.description: Destination devices this SSH rule applies to, e.g. 'tag:server' or 'autogroup:self'.

checkPeriod.description: How often re-authorization is required when action is 'check', e.g. '12h' or 'always'.

recorder.description: Tailscale IPs or tags of session-recorder hosts. Sessions are streamed to all reachable recorders.

enforceRecorder.description: If true, reject the SSH session when no recorder from the Recorder list is reachable.

deny.description: Destination:port pairs the source must NOT be allowed to reach.

src.description: Source identity for this test: user email, tag, or Tailscale IP.

accept.description: Destination:port pairs the source must be allowed to reach.

srcPostureAttrs.description: Device attribute key/value pairs to simulate when evaluating posture checks for this test.

ip.description: Permitted destination IP addresses or CIDR ranges.

app.description: Application-level access rules keyed by app name.

srcPosture.description: Posture checks that must pass for the source device.

via.description: App Connector identities through which access is tunnelled.

target.description: Devices to grant attributes to: tags, users, autogroups, or '*' for all devices.

attr.description: Capability attribute names to grant, e.g. 'funnel', 'mullvad', 'app-connector'.

app.description: Application-connector route configuration keyed by app name.

ipPool.description: IP address pool to assign to matched devices.

name.description: App name, used to match traffic for this app connector route.

connectors.description: Tags or IPs of the App Connector devices to route through.

domains.description: DNS domains whose traffic is routed through this app connector.

title: Tailscale ACL Policy
description: JSON Schema for the Tailscale network access control policy file (policy.hujson). See https://tailscale.com/kb/1018/acls for documentation.
